=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py:165-170 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The plan() comment says "the commit range after the live copy's last commit is empty here, so it holds the path as no_template_commits", and changelog.d/8405-live-sync-both-copies.md line 2 says "so the path lands on the held draft PR (`reason=no_template_commits`) for a human to merge". Both are false for multi-commit pushes: if commit C1 changes both copies and a later commit C2 changes only the template, `_template_commits()` (lines 327-350) returns `[C2]`, and if C2 passes provenance in `_classify_paths()` (lines 466-483) the path goes to the auto-merge-eligible `ai/sync-claude-live-copies` PR instead of the held draft.
  WHY: This is not a new privilege, because it follows the existing provenance contract. But the comment and changelog promise every both-changed path a human-reviewed held PR, so operators will expect a held PR that never appears. Source severity was NIT, mapped to low.
- agents.md:2802-2821 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Live `.claude/` copies and their templates" section (lines 2804-2806 / 2802-2809: "When the push changed a template but not its live copy, it copies the template over...", and line 2821: "Logs add `CLAUDE_LIVE_SYNC authorized`, `held`, and `converted_to_draft`") still describes template-only syncs. It leaves out the new both-changed recovery in plan() (scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py:164-176 and :194-199) and the new `CLAUDE_LIVE_SYNC both_changed ... action=template_wins|left_for_parity` log key.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but the operator contract is stale. Per §25 the fix is an agents.d/8405-*.md fragment, which the plan grant for agents.d/* already covers; agents.md should not be edited directly. Both reviewers rated it NIT, mapped to low.
- tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py:657-658 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The continuation line of `test_sync_pr_rejects_malformed_entries` was re-indented from a tab plus spaces to tabs only, which is a whitespace-only change in a test the issue does not touch.
  WHY: Behaviour does not change, but the edit adds diff churn and conflict surface, against the §9 minimal-change rule. Both reviewers rated it NIT, mapped to low. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly declined to report this: it argued the change was needed because ruff `E101` (mixed spaces and tabs) would flag the old line once the file was touched.
- scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py:189-199 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The catch-up branch (`elif recover_both_changed and template_sha and live_sha == template_sha`, line 194) does not log `both_changed path=... action=left_for_parity` when `recover_both_changed=False`. The main push branch (lines 171-176) does log it. As a result, a both-changed catch-up path in the CI parity `sync --dry-run` is skipped silently.
  WHY: An operator running the dry-run cannot tell "no drift" apart from "dry-run intentionally skipped recovery". This is an observability gap, not a correctness bug, because the parity test still catches the drift. Source severity was NIT, mapped to low.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Update the contract in `agents.md` to reflect the new sync behavior, including the new `CLAUDE_LIVE_SYNC both_changed` log event and the revised sync trigger. This ties to the issue #8405 constraint: "the `CLAUDE_LIVE_SYNC` log keys; new log reasons are added alongside the existing ones."
  expected_change_site: agents.d/8405-live-sync-both-copies.md (a fragment targeting the agents.md "Live `.claude/` copies and their templates" section, currently line 2821)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR includes no agents.d/8405-*.md fragment, and `glob agents.d/*8405*` returns no files, even though the PR's `files_touched` scope covers agents.d/*. The agents.md registry still lists only `authorized`, `held`, and `converted_to_draft`, while `both_changed` is now emitted at runtime and is mentioned only in prose in changelog.d/8405-live-sync-both-copies.md.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py:plan(), lines 165-170; changelog.d/8405-live-sync-both-copies.md line 2 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comment and changelog say a both-changed path is always held as `no_template_commits`. This is false when a later template-only commit in the same push (C1 changes both copies, then C2 changes only the template) passes provenance: `_template_commits()` (lines 327-350) checks `C1..after` = `[C2]`, and `_classify_paths()` (lines 466-483) can then route the path to the auto-merge-eligible `ai/sync-claude-live-copies` PR.
  WHY: This is the provenance contract that already existed, not a new privilege, but the documentation promise is wrong. Suggested rewording: "holds it as no_template_commits unless a later commit in the push changed the template, which goes through the normal provenance check".
- agents.md:lines 2804-2806 and line 2821 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The "Live `.claude/` copies and their templates" section describes only template-only syncs and omits the new both-changed trigger from plan() (lines 171-174, catch-up lines 194-199) and the `CLAUDE_LIVE_SYNC both_changed ... action=template_wins|left_for_parity` log key.
  WHY: Nothing breaks, but the operator contract is stale. The fix should be an agents.d/8405-*.md fragment per §25, not a direct edit to agents.md.
- Not reported (verification notes): The pass-1 BLOCKERs about test_gh_api_write_guard.py::test_template_parity, test_pr_watch_guard.py and test_claude_template_live_parity.py are rejected, because the check runs show failed_count: 0 of 23 and pending_template_paths() at tests/claude_template_drift.py lines 100-104 does not touch those hooks. The pass-1 NIT about the line-658 re-indent is rejected because ruff E101 required the change. No task gaps: every deliverable and all five tests are present. The trust boundary holds: `recover_both_changed=False` at line 665 for the ci.yml line 545 dry-run, and no GitHub API calls were added.
- HARDENING: add "unless a later template-only commit in the same push passes provenance" to the plan() comment and the changelog sentence (about 2 lines); HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
